Type: cabinet
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Media Cabinet with Self-Closing Doors, 59"W
Colors: Walnut/White
This media cabinet features 3 cabinets and 2 shelves for plenty of storage. Self-closing cabinet doors help you avoid damage and clutter. An all-over light finish means that this cabinet can blend in any living room, den, or media room, making it the perfect space for all your entertainment items. 59"W x 17"D x 21"H MDF and metal The light finish will fit into most any room's color scheme. This cabinet has 3 self-closing cabinet doors and 2 shelves. Assemble in 15-30 minutes Clean with a soft cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
